HTTPValidationError.description: FastAPI-compatible validation envelope retained as a stable HTTP contract.

referenced.description: True iff some loaded soundboard has an item with this file path.

post.description:
Revert from an uploaded journal (the downloaded batch JSON). Exists
for the disaster path — app.db was wiped/rebuilt so the server-side
batch row is gone, but journal items carry paths and survive re-minted
track ids.

parameters.description: Folder path relative to the configured music directory.
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: Delete contents too; otherwise non-empty folders are refused.
parameters.name: recursive

get.description:
Download the playlist as M3U (default; for VLC, foobar2000, etc.) or
JSON (structured, includes track metadata for re-import). M3U paths are
relative to MUSIC_DIR — drop the file at MUSIC_DIR's root to import.

200.description: All critical components can accept traffic

503.description: A critical component is still starting or unavailable

get.description:
1. Path must normalise without traversal segments.
2. Path must resolve inside SFX_LIBRARY_DIR.
3. Path must be referenced by at least one loaded mode's soundboards.

get.summary:
Flat list of every SFX file, recursive. Used by the soundboard editor
to populate the file picker without round-tripping per folder.

Whole folder hierarchy in one response — same contract as the music
library's GET /api/library/folders, for the client-side tree.

The SFX files immediately in this folder. The folder hierarchy comes
from `/folders` (one whole-tree response) — the client builds the tree
from that, so this endpoint returns only the file list.

post.summary:
Report which proposed (dest, name) targets already exist under the SFX
root, so the client can ask about duplicates before sending bytes.
